title: DiarizationResult
description: Canonical polyvoice diarization result (schema family `diarization-result-v1`). This is the machine-readable contract for the `--json` CLI output, the Python/FFI projections, and the MCP `diarize` tool. Evolution within v1 is strictly additive: optional fields (notably `turns[].text`, `exclusive_turns`, per-speaker `embedding`, and per-word transcription) may appear; a consumer that ignores unknown fields stays forward-compatible. Schema decision: keep v1 with additive optional fields rather than bumping to v2 — all new fields are optional/omitted-when-empty.

schema_version.description: Schema family identifier. Stable across additive changes.

segments.description: Raw per-window segments before turn merging.

turns.description: Merged speaker turns — the primary overlap-aware 'who spoke when' output.

exclusive_turns.description: ADDITIVE single-speaker (exclusive) timeline for ASR reconciliation: at most one speaker per frame, derived from `turns` by a deterministic per-frame argmax. Omitted when empty. Not a replacement for overlap-aware `turns`.

speaker.description: Numeric speaker id, or null if not yet clustered.

confidence.description: Assignment confidence in [0,1] from a logistic map of embedding-to-centroid cosine similarity (or a raw posterior when available). Ranking score — not a calibrated probability of label correctness.

text.description: Transcript for this turn. ADDITIVE: present only when an ASR backend (polyvoice-asr) ran the who-said-what cascade; absent otherwise.

stable.description: ADDITIVE: whether the speaker label has stabilized. Streaming may emit provisional labels (`stable: false`) that can still change until the speaker cache reaches its stability threshold; offline pipeline turns are always stable. Present only when false — omitted when true, and an absent field deserializes as true, so offline payloads stay unchanged.

word.description: ADDITIVE per-word alignment, emitted only by the who-said-what surfaces (diarize + ASR). Not part of the bare diarization result.

speaker.description: Attributed speaker id (dominant on overlap), or null.

confidence.description: ASR confidence in [0,1], scaled by turn-coverage share.

interpolated.description: ADDITIVE: true when timestamps were nearest-neighbor filled because ASR left them missing or zero-duration. Absent/false means ASR timestamps were used as-is.

embedding.description: ADDITIVE optional L2-normalized mean embedding for this speaker (embedder dimension). Omitted unless embeddings were requested/attached.
